rawContent: Can we expect  film industry people to make songs and create spoof videos or dialogues making fun of #metoo ?! I won’t be surprised, already there are many going around :)

There are courts & Counsellers, then why #metoo⁠ ⁠?! It is definitely for change of mindset and serves as voice for voiceless and tries to reinstate the shame is not with the victim:) if empowered women hesitated to talk & go to court, how do u expect daily wage earners to?!
@MahjuReyaz @ZeeTamil I still strongly support #meetoo but there are people who say there r better ways to handle harassment rather than than #metoo & social media :)

Enakkum anubhavam undu, Ramki sirkku ellamae theriyum, avar supportla naanae handle panneettaen, but there are girls who don’t have that support, and the society victimises the victims, #metoo will yield results with respect to mindset.

#su was nothing but #metoo in another form. Dud my best with 100% sincerity within the framework available. Girls exposed the boy and it is the duty of the officials to take up the case, just like #metoo. And more importantly change the mindset towards women who dare to talk.

Seeing the comments on the press meet i attended yest Shocking! A non commercial #metoo attracts so much criticism & personal attacks, wondering how we managed to reveal so many stories of ordinary people on a commercial platform ! No wonder we had a set of haters #SU @ZeeTamil

That is like a man @onlynikil and really hope you treat the young girls who come with dreams & passion , with due respect. We need to take this movement forward with a positive approach and achieve the purpose of #metoo⁠ ⁠, which is levelling the ground😍

Only objective of #metoo is to achieve levelling of ground for all & be the voice for voiceless. while working towards the goal people may get exposed,  cannot blame the victims for that!! Same case with #SU , but it was in a commercial format, but I used it with 100% sincerity.

Should we debate on case to Case & risk of misuse  involved with #metoo or ban  #metoo because twitter & Facebook are getting mileage out of it?! Why double standards, because people who came to #SU were not celebrities? encountered pathetic sexual abuse cases in #Su , if only...

@AkshaySrijay @Chinmayi Definitely you have to talk it out, and discuss with others in the family and put an end to it. When it comes to work place, people in influential positions tend to take advantage and that is where such a mass movement helps #metoo

@arunkumarchitr1 :) I heard #metoo stories for 7 years not from celebrities! But from daily wage earners who were sometimes@not sure about their next meal. We did whatever we could to empower them@and create awareness.

@arunkumarchitr1 I heard the audio too, the conversation is not between the victim & the offender, there is a third person who is talking and he has recorded. How sure can you be about this? #metoo is about the victim calling out!

I had shared my most horrifying #metoo story in one of the discussions recently. Got a call from the media house now, saying they r not in a position to publish becas one of the big names is their business associate :) Understand their predicament,should I share it or leave it?!

@Sankararaman1 Handled it myself with faith, self discipline & family support. Many women don’t have the support I had, #metoo is all about changing the mindset & reassuring . Shame is not with the victim, but the predators. Moral support has to come from the society, not court rooms.

#metoo stories r not just in cinema, my worst experience was when I was in Muscat , in the business circuit. My story is proof enough that world is full of opportunities & without compromising on ethics, we may still find happiness. May not be super successful, doesn’t matter :)

When offender is powerful & has the clout, you r worried about your family’s safety. I decided to take a step back, move away though it was a huge career decision. The point is, women need not do this, it is unfair!! We need to level the ground which is the objective of #metoo

#metoo will yield results, coming generations girls will be in the same platform as their counterparts. Isn’t that wonderful?! Some women decided to open up for the sake of everyone, personal vengeance is not in the agenda. Society shud make the change, change of mindset.
How happy we are from inside is v important, success means different things to different people. But, things should change for the better, we owe it to our girls, change the mindset  #metoo

@sgmanjari @LeenaManimekali @TamilTheHindu @ThanthiTV @PTTVEnglish @thenewsminute @news7tamil_eng @AnandaVikatan @ZeeNewsTamil @igtamil @Chinmayi @the_hindu @ChennaiTimesTOI @TheQuint @redpixnews Yes, when victims speak, offenders will get exposed, some may misuse , we need to find out ways & means of tackling it, but don’t u agree that mindset has to change & #metoo is all about that?
And nobody said we don’t have faith in Police, pls don’t distort🙏 I said society did not give us the comfort of filing a complaint without being judged! That is exactly what is happening now! #metoo

@sgmanjari @LeenaManimekali @TamilTheHindu @ThanthiTV @PTTVEnglish @thenewsminute @news7tamil_eng @AnandaVikatan @ZeeNewsTamil @igtamil @Chinmayi @the_hindu @ChennaiTimesTOI @TheQuint @redpixnews Manjari, #metoo is a movement and I truly believe it is a big leap towards social reform. I never asked women where the offender touched you!! And never said so many women are not raped, how come you are only raped!!! There is a difference between rape & harassment dear!

Some complained that I took salary & it has a commercial angle, some said celebrities r not being brought or their stories not discussed! Now #metoo is not  commercial & does not exclude celebrities :) but still back lash is phenomenal! Problem is mindset! & the insecure men :)

I stand by people who haven’t negotiated  self respect 4  sake of opportunities & my heart goes out to people whose opportunities were snatched away becas they didn’t sell their self respect. #Metoo will  change  the culture of expecting sexual favours in return of opportunities.

Thank you for the beautiful AV @ZeeTamil & the opportunity to touch so many lives🙏 whether it is a show involving ordinary people or a non commercial movement led by celebrities #metoo⁠ ⁠ which addresses inequality of all sorts, I shall lend my voice, no matter what :)

I just now read an article publishing my #metoo story. Have a small request to press, pls   don’t exaggerate / distort and make it cheap🙏it is a sensitive issue & give it it’s due . Please don’t dilute the movement🙏

Bombarded with v disturbing questions after the pressmeet on #metoo I make it clear that I don’t research on caste or creed of people who called out or accused! I don’t believe, being born in a certain clan or being born as MALE is a qualification! Kindly don’t politicise #metoo

I was invited for the #metoo pressmeet by South Indian film Womens asso, not by @Chinmayi @LeenaManimekali . Went  for the association as they said becas they r not actors/ celebrities, their voice is not being heard . Chinmaye came late, she said she was not aware of pressmeet.

#Rajalakshmi incident is the worst form of #metoo , if we have to stop this, we need to talk , though that is not the only way to solution. Why so much perversion? Men still think a woman/ female is only for that?!!! Is it deep down embedded?!!! How r we going to clean this up?

#MeToo In my observation, there r many angry men, they r angry because of low self esteem, rejection, insecurity. Who is creating this insecurity in them? How can we get redemption from this? Unless this is addressed , there won’t be solution for crime, harassment& perversion

These people are worse than terrorists! When we talk about violence against women & children, they politicise it & give caste color. In Tamilnadu #metoo is given caste reference?! Real Tamilnadu is not this! We have the culture of adoring our Mothers & sisters & respecting women

Warmest wishes & season’s greetings dear people😍

Trying not to allow myself to be pulled down by embarrassment for being open with #metoo experiences. Hope this will change for the better one day & offenders will have to bear the cross:) 

இனிய தீபாவளி நல் வாழ்த்துக்கள் 🙏
Watched @amirkingkhan chat show with @karanjohar  truly reassuring! the gentlemen in the industry , know, acknowledge & respect #metoo voices😍

#DirectorAmeer, please don’t poison minds, the arrow you shot at me will be directed at u sooner or later, casteism is bad for all!!And just like the pics at #bjp office which was taken 2/3 yrs back is misused now, my #MeToo story is misquoted by #DirAmeer 4 a hidden agenda👎
I think there are a few gentlemen in our industry who are standing by the voices of #metoo without bias & prejudice  ⁦@Actor_Siddharth⁩ 🙏 https://t.co/NGyXSgcL6J

@Chinmayi I suggest you sort it out with the union, may not be linked with your involvement with #metoo . Keep both separate & approach without emotional attachment. Union is meant for protecting its members, you may have contributed quite a bit, they cannot afford to lose you :)

I was called to join protest by Tamras members, against 
Mr Narayanan. I express my solidarity & support #metoo 
There should be no personal or communal agenda and there is no pardon for the crimes against #Nirbhaya #Hasini  #Nandini  #Rajalakshmi  #honorkillings

My brothers & collegues including #DirAmeer may research on which caste the accused belong to and figure out the reasons for the victim’s allegations, or even brush it aside saying it is ‘rich people’s’ cry for attention #Metoo https://t.co/Pj6wetoXaJ

The guy was exposed & the girl got some relief from that! This is one reason people came to #SU ! Agreed it is a double edged sword, but so is #Metoo ! But #SU was in commercial format, but all shows r not TRPhunts #SU evolved over 7 yrs kudos to @ZeeTamil
#Metoo Unfortunately many women are being insensitive! Gentlemen have been much more understanding & supportive 😍
Had an interview with #Nakkheeran , they asked me why I didn’t talk about #Rajalakshmi in the #Metoo press meet, pressmeet was in 20th Oct & #Rajalakshmi incident on Oct 22nd night, how will I talk?!

Like #metoo stories, those told on #SU by victims, deserved to be heard too! Chances of any platform being misused for accusing someone of sexual harassment is pretty rare ! Dialogues happened in the presence of those accused,  giving them opportunity to clarify their side!

Expecting some of those ‘dignified’ people to say #metoo stories are midnight masala stuff, they shouldn’t be permitted to talk openly on social media when there is court & there are counsellors to tackle these issues:)

There might be a ban on publishing #metoo stories considering the privacy intrusion into personal life of the ‘ predators’ or ‘accused’. Social media platforms may not  be allowed to carry #metoo stories, which are detrimental to the society as there is risk of manipulation :)

What I spoke on #SU was never planned, the show evolved as a movement for the poor & wronged , when those who came there started using the platforform to tell their #metoo stories. Haters & mockers did their best but #SU is still close to many hearts :) @ZeeTamil

What if #Metoomovement takes a broader form and people come forward to share their #metoo stories of deceit & abuse by partners/spouses?!! Internet will explode?!!! That day is not far :) Many dared to do that on #SU already !!
@Preya2129 @ZeeTamil I am not bothered about the haters ma, I am bothered about those helpless  women !! I know for sure #SU was their #metoo platform!

@karthikbk7 We need to empathise & stand in their shoes to understand why victims go to the extend of exposing on  media. In most cases , attitude of people around them & social pressures are worse than the abuse itself, & that is where media comes into picture, to break the stigma #MeToo
